formula_result: Degenerate for this app: all 7 routes live in the single module app/server.py, whose inbound-reference count is 0 (it's the process entrypoint, nothing imports it) -- the literal formula gives every route the same (zero) weight and provides no discrimination.
adaptation: Backlog ordering therefore uses a documented, LOW-CONFIDENCE secondary heuristic instead: routes on the core domain resource (tickets) are assumed higher-usage than support routes (auth) or the known-likely-dead admin export (see DNP-002), on the ordinary assumption that a ticket tracker's primary traffic is ticket CRUD. This is an assumption, not a measurement -- replace with real weights the moment P2 can be re-run against logs/APM.

pain_weight_note: Pain weight (separate axis from usage weight, per schema.md#risk-score) is NOT a proxy -- it is directly evidenced from the problem brief: routes touching PB-001 (close_ticket, request_reset) and PB-002 (request_reset, confirm_reset) get elevated pain weight regardless of usage rank.
